mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 63 degrees near the Verona Public Library.

City updates include a police report from September 10th regarding a burglary and weapons offence in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way. Additionally, notices for the upcoming November 2026 general election are now available.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at local venues like Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival brings excitement to our streets, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness on September 14th.
On September 10th, officers were dispatched to a residential burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way. The suspect was taken into custody and a handgun was recovered at the scene.
If you are looking for a sweet snack, today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The Verona Culver's location will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
